title: Chang'an's Lychees
title_zh: 长安的荔枝
summary_en: A historical novel depicting the journey of transporting fresh lychees to the capital during the Tang dynasty, reflecting politics, power, and human fate.
summary_zh: 一部以唐代荔枝进贡为背景的历史小说，展现了政治博弈、人性命运与权力角逐。
best_quote_en: A lychee from Lingnan may decide the fate of the entire empire.
best_quote_zh: 岭南一颗荔枝，关乎天下之势。

title: The Three-Body Problem
title_zh: 三体
summary_en: A sci-fi classic exploring first contact between humanity and an alien civilization from a three-sun system.
summary_zh: 描写地球文明与三体文明第一次接触的科幻经典，探讨人类的未来与文明的冲突。
best_quote_en: Weakness and ignorance are not barriers to survival, arrogance is.
best_quote_zh: 弱小和无知不是生存的障碍，傲慢才是。

title: Records of the Ming Dynasty
title_zh: 明朝那些事儿
summary_en: A popular history book that retells the Ming dynasty's events in a witty and accessible style.
summary_zh: 以生动幽默的语言讲述明朝历史，让历史变得有趣又容易理解。
best_quote_en: History is not only about emperors and generals, but also about ordinary people's joys and sorrows.
best_quote_zh: 历史不仅是帝王将相的故事，也是百姓悲欢的记录。

title: To Live
title_zh: 活着
summary_en: A story of an ordinary man enduring hardships and tragedies, yet choosing to live on.
summary_zh: 讲述一个普通人在苦难与悲剧中仍然选择活下去的故事。
best_quote_en: To live is to bear the suffering of life with patience and dignity.
best_quote_zh: 活着，就是忍受生命赋予我们的苦难。

title: Ordinary World
title_zh: 平凡的世界
summary_en: A realist novel reflecting the lives, struggles, and dreams of ordinary people in China's reform era.
summary_zh: 一部现实主义作品，描写改革年代普通人的生活、奋斗与理想。
best_quote_en: Even in the most ordinary life, there is a shining strength.
best_quote_zh: 即使是平凡的生活，也有闪光的力量。

title: Awakening of Cognition
title_zh: 认知觉醒
summary_en: A book on how to improve cognition, optimize habits, and achieve personal growth.
summary_zh: 一本探讨如何提升认知、优化习惯，实现自我成长的作品。
best_quote_en: Cognition determines destiny; the higher your perspective, the farther you can go.
best_quote_zh: 认知决定命运，站得越高，看得越远。

title: The Little Prince
title_zh: 小王子
source: 安托万·德·圣-埃克苏佩里
summary_en: A poetic fable about a young prince exploring the universe and discovering love, loneliness, and meaning.
summary_zh: 一部诗意的寓言，讲述小王子探索宇宙，发现爱、孤独与意义的故事。
best_quote_en: What is essential is invisible to the eye.
best_quote_zh: 真正重要的东西，用眼睛是看不见的。

title: Destiny
title_zh: 命运
summary_en: A novel that weaves family stories and fate, reflecting the struggles of ordinary people.
summary_zh: 一部交织家庭故事与命运的小说，展现普通人的挣扎与生命张力。
best_quote_en: Fate is like the tide, sometimes pushing us forward, sometimes pulling us back.
best_quote_zh: 命运如潮，有时推着我们前进，有时把我们拉回。

title: One Sentence Worth Ten Thousand
title_zh: 一句顶一万句
summary_en: A novel about the difficulty of communication and the loneliness of individuals in modern society.
summary_zh: 一部描写沟通困境与现代人孤独的小说。
best_quote_en: People talk endlessly, but only one sentence truly hits the heart.
best_quote_zh: 人们说了一万句废话，可能只有一句说到心里。

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
title_zh: 百年孤独
source: 加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯
summary_en: A masterpiece of magical realism, narrating the rise and fall of the Buendía family over a century.
summary_zh: 魔幻现实主义经典，讲述布恩迪亚家族百年的兴衰史。
best_quote_en: Many years later, as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendía was to remember that distant afternoon when his father took him to discover ice.
best_quote_zh: 多年以后，奥雷连诺上校站在行刑队面前，必将想起父亲带他去见识冰块的那个遥远的下午。

title: Murati翁荔陈丹琦公司发布首个产品，让大模型微调门槛暴降
title_zh: Murati翁荔陈丹琦公司发布首个产品，让大模型微调门槛暴降
summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab launches Tinker, making AI model fine-tuning as simple as modifying Python code.
summary_zh: Thinking Machines Lab发布Tinker产品，使大模型微调像修改Python代码一样简单。
best_quote_en: Tinker achieves an exceptional balance between abstraction and tunability, giving researchers 90% control over data, loss functions, and algorithms.
best_quote_zh: Tinker在抽象化和可调性之间取得了卓越的平衡，让研究者保留了90%的控制权，主要涉及数据、损失函数和算法本身。

title: Accelerating Qwen3-8B Agent on Intel® Core™ Ultra with Depth-Pruned Draft Models
title_zh: 使用深度修剪草稿模型在英特尔®酷睿™Ultra上加速Qwen3-8B智能体
summary_en: Intel demonstrates how depth-pruned draft models with speculative decoding accelerate Qwen3-8B agent inference by 1.4x on Intel Core Ultra processors.
summary_zh: 英特尔展示如何通过深度修剪草稿模型和推测解码，在酷睿Ultra处理器上将Qwen3-8B智能体推理速度提升1.4倍。
best_quote_en: This demonstrates how pruning + speculative decoding can unlock faster and more efficient inference—making local AI agents even more practical.
best_quote_zh: 这展示了修剪与推测解码如何解锁更快更高效的推理——使本地AI智能体更加实用。

title: 消息称宗馥莉“心腹”严学峰被立案调查，涉嫌违纪
title_zh: 消息称宗馥莉“心腹”严学峰被立案调查，涉嫌违纪
summary_en: Yan Xuefeng, a close associate of Zong Fuli at Wahaha Group, is under investigation for disciplinary violations in Hangzhou.
summary_zh: 娃哈哈集团宗馥莉心腹严学峰因涉嫌违纪被杭州市纪委立案调查。
best_quote_en: Yan Xuefeng is being investigated for personal reasons, according to a senior Wahaha Group executive.
best_quote_zh: 一名娃哈哈集团高层人士对财新表示，严学峰被调查是因为私人原因。

title: Meta will serve ads based on your AI chats
title_zh: Meta将根据你的AI聊天内容投放广告
summary_en: Meta will use AI chatbot conversations for personalized advertising without opt-out options, following industry monetization trends.
summary_zh: Meta将根据AI聊天内容推送个性化广告且无法选择退出，反映行业变现趋势。
best_quote_en: Meta could soon use almost anything you say to its chatbot to try to sell you stuff more effectively on its platforms.
best_quote_zh: Meta很快就能利用你与聊天机器人的几乎所有对话，在其平台上更有效地向你推销产品。

title: [Outliers] Ed Stack: Lessons from Dick’s Sporting Goods
title_zh: 【异类】埃德·斯塔克：迪克体育用品的经验教训
source: Farnam Street (FS Blog, Thinking & Growth, English)
summary_en: Ed Stack shares 11 business lessons from transforming his father's struggling store into a billion-dollar sporting goods empire.
summary_zh: 埃德·斯塔克分享11条商业经验，讲述如何将父亲的困境小店打造成数十亿美元的体育用品帝国。
best_quote_en: Trust isn't earned in the easy times; it's earned in the fire.
best_quote_zh: 信任不是在轻松时刻赢得的；而是在烈火中赢得的。

title: 机器人“狂踹不倒”视频刷屏！太空舱遍布城市街巷，银河通用这几手秀麻了
title_zh: 机器人“狂踹不倒”视频刷屏！太空舱遍布城市街巷，银河通用这几手秀麻了
summary_en: Galaxy General's Any2Track enables robots to maintain stability while imitating human movements and adapting to real-world disturbances.
summary_zh: 银河通用Any2Track框架让机器人在模仿人类动作时保持稳定，并实时适应现实干扰。
best_quote_en: Any2Track achieves zero-shot sim2real, making robots perform complex actions as steadily as an old dog.
best_quote_zh: Any2Track实现了零样本sim2real，让机器人做起复杂动作来，依旧稳如老狗。

title: SOTA OCR on-device with Core ML and dots.ocr
title_zh: SOTA OCR 在设备端通过 Core ML 和 dots.ocr 实现
summary_en: A technical guide converting dots.OCR to run on-device using Core ML and MLX, detailing model simplification and optimization challenges.
summary_zh: 技术指南：使用 Core ML 和 MLX 将 dots.OCR 转换为在设备端运行，详述模型简化与优化挑战。
best_quote_en: The Neural Engine is 12x more power efficient than CPU and 4x more power efficient than GPU, making it ideal for on-device AI.
best_quote_zh: 神经引擎比 CPU 节能 12 倍，比 GPU 节能 4 倍，是设备端 AI 的理想选择。

title: 岚图汽车递交港股上市申请
title_zh: 岚图汽车递交港股上市申请
summary_en: Lantu Auto applies for Hong Kong IPO with rapid revenue growth and plans to expand product lineup and retail network.
summary_zh: 岚图汽车申请港股上市，收入快速增长，计划扩大产品线和零售网络。
best_quote_en: From 2022 to 2024, Lantu Auto achieved a compound growth rate of 78.9% in revenue.
best_quote_zh: 2022年至2024年，岚图汽车收入复合增速达78.9%。

title: Private company’s labor market data will have to do
title_zh: 私营公司劳动力市场数据将不得不使用
summary_en: Private ADP jobs data shows unexpected September losses as government shutdown delays official BLS report, leaving economists and Fed without key labor insights.
summary_zh: 政府停摆期间，私营ADP就业数据显示九月意外下滑，替代官方报告为决策提供参考。
best_quote_en: That could mean the Fed will have to make its decision about whether to further cut interest rates in a few weeks without the benefit of the most recent data to guide them.
best_quote_zh: 这可能意味着美联储将不得不在没有最新数据指导的情况下，决定是否在未来几周进一步降息。

title: [Outliers] Hetty Green: The Witch of Wall Street
title_zh: 异类：华尔街女巫海蒂·格林
source: Farnam Street (FS Blog, Thinking & Growth, English)
summary_en: The story of Hetty Green, who became America's richest woman in the 1800s through contrarian investing, extreme frugality, and fierce independence.
summary_zh: 19世纪海蒂·格林通过逆向投资、极度节俭和独立自主成为美国最富有女性的传奇故事。
best_quote_en: "I buy when things are low and nobody wants them. I keep them until they go up and people are crazy to get them."
best_quote_zh: “我在东西便宜没人要时买入，持有到价格上涨人们疯狂想要时卖出。”

title: 机器人“狂踹不倒”视频刷屏！太空舱遍布城市街巷，银河通用这几手秀麻了
title_zh: 机器人“狂踹不倒”视频刷屏！太空舱遍布城市街巷，银河通用这几手秀麻了
summary_en: Galaxy General Robotics introduces Any2Track, a framework enabling humanoid robots to precisely imitate human motions while maintaining stability under real-world disturbances.
summary_zh: 银河通用发布Any2Track框架，使人形机器人精准模仿人类动作并在干扰下保持稳定。
best_quote_en: Any2Track not only allows robots to accurately imitate various complex human actions, but also adapts in real-time to real-world interference.
best_quote_zh: Any2Track不仅能让机器人精确模仿各种人类复杂动作，还能实时适应各种真实世界的干扰。

title: SOTA OCR on-device with Core ML and dots.ocr
title_zh: 使用 Core ML 和 dots.ocr 在设备上实现 SOTA OCR
summary_en: A technical guide converting dots.OCR model to Core ML for on-device deployment with practical troubleshooting steps.
summary_zh: 技术指南：将 dots.OCR 模型转换为 Core ML，实现设备端部署及实用故障排除步骤。
best_quote_en: Every year our hardware is a little more powerful, our models a little smarter for each parameter. In 2025, it is more feasible than ever to run truly competitive models on-device.
best_quote_zh: 每年我们的硬件都更强大一点，我们的模型在每个参数上都更智能一点。在2025年，在设备上运行真正具有竞争力的模型比以往任何时候都更加可行。

title: 埃及央行宣布降息100个基点
title_zh: 埃及央行宣布降息100个基点
summary_en: Egypt's central bank cuts benchmark interest rates by 100 basis points for the fourth time this year.
summary_zh: 埃及央行连续第四次降息100基点，符合市场预期。
best_quote_en: Egypt's central bank decided to cut the benchmark interest rate by 100 basis points, with adjusted overnight deposit and lending rates at 21% and 22% respectively.
best_quote_zh: 埃及中央银行货币政策委员会当天决定，将基准利率下调100个基点，调整后的隔夜存贷款利率分别为21%和22%。

title: Private company’s labor market data will have to do
title_zh: 私营公司劳动力市场数据将不得不使用
summary_en: With government shutdown delaying official jobs data, private ADP report showing 32,000 job losses becomes crucial for economic insights.
summary_zh: 政府停摆延迟官方就业数据，私营ADP报告显示失业3.2万成为关键经济参考。
best_quote_en: That could mean the Fed will have to make its decision about whether to further cut interest rates in a few weeks without the benefit of the most recent data to guide them.
best_quote_zh: 这可能意味着美联储将在几周后决定是否进一步降息，而没有最新数据作为指导。

title: [Outliers] Hetty Green: The Witch of Wall Street
title_zh: 异类：华尔街女巫赫蒂·格林
source: Farnam Street (FS Blog, Thinking & Growth, English)
summary_en: Hetty Green became America's richest woman through contrarian investing, extreme frugality, and maintaining massive cash reserves during financial panics.
summary_zh: 赫蒂·格林通过逆向投资、极度节俭和在金融危机中保持现金储备，成为美国最富有的女性。
best_quote_en: "I buy when things are low and nobody wants them. I keep them until they go up and people are crazy to get them."
best_quote_zh: “我在东西便宜没人要时买入，一直持有到价格上涨人们疯狂抢购时卖出。”

title: OpenAI强硬回击马斯克窃密诉讼！xAI被指恶意人肉离职员工
title_zh: OpenAI强硬回击马斯克窃密诉讼！xAI被指恶意人肉离职员工
summary_en: OpenAI strongly denies Musk's xAI lawsuit alleging systematic poaching and trade secret theft, calling it corporate bullying tactics.
summary_zh: OpenAI强硬回应马斯克xAI窃密诉讼，否认指控并指责对方恶意人肉员工。
best_quote_en: OpenAI stated it has not obtained, accessed, or used any xAI confidential information, and all recruitment practices are legal and compliant.
best_quote_zh: OpenAI未获取、未接触，也未使用任何xAI机密信息，所有招聘行为全都合法合规。

title: Introducing RTEB: A New Standard for Retrieval Evaluation
title_zh: RTEB 介绍：检索评估的新标准
summary_en: RTEB introduces a hybrid benchmark using open and private datasets to reliably evaluate embedding model retrieval accuracy for real-world applications.
summary_zh: RTEB 采用开放与私有数据集混合策略，为现实应用提供可靠的嵌入模型检索评估标准。
best_quote_en: RTEB addresses the generalization gap with a hybrid strategy that provides a clear, unbiased measure of a model’s ability to generalize to unseen data.
best_quote_zh: RTEB 通过混合策略解决泛化差距，提供清晰、无偏的模型处理未知数据能力评估。

title: 德国政府据悉计划上调2025年经济增长预期
title_zh: 德国政府据悉计划上调2025年经济增长预期
summary_en: German government reportedly plans to raise 2025 growth forecast to 0.2% from zero growth.
summary_zh: 德国政府据悉将2025年经济增长预期从零上调至0.2%。
best_quote_en: The revised data will align with estimates from Germany's leading research institutes published last month.
best_quote_zh: 这些修订后的数据将与德国主要研究机构上月公布的预估相符。

title: Everyone seems to want AI in their feeds
title_zh: 每个人似乎都想在信息流中加入AI
summary_en: OpenAI's Sora AI video app tops App Store charts amid viral adoption and concerns about AI-generated content and deepfakes.
summary_zh: OpenAI的Sora AI视频应用登顶App Store，引发病毒式采用及对AI生成内容和深度伪造的担忧。
best_quote_en: OpenAI is betting that infusing feeds with personalized AI can keep people engaged.
best_quote_zh: OpenAI押注于通过个性化AI注入信息流来保持用户参与度。

title: Barry Diller: Building IAC
title_zh: 巴里·迪勒：打造IAC
source: Farnam Street (FS Blog, Thinking & Growth, English)
summary_en: Barry Diller shares business wisdom on instinct, trust, and lifelong learning from his decades building media empires.
summary_zh: 巴里·迪勒分享数十年打造媒体帝国的商业智慧：直觉、信任和终身学习。
best_quote_en: "Data can tell you what has happened, not what can or will happen."
best_quote_zh: "数据可以告诉你发生了什么，但不能告诉你可能或将会发生什么。"

title: КРАКЕН ОНИОН ДАРКНЕТ ССЫЛКА
title_zh: KRAKEN 洋葱暗网链接
summary_en: A guide on registering anonymously on darknet sites using Tor and VPNs for security and privacy protection.
summary_zh: 关于使用Tor和VPN匿名注册暗网站点以保护安全和隐私的指南。
best_quote_en: When registering on Kraken sites or using Kraken darknet, anonymity is not just an option but a necessity.
best_quote_zh: 当您在Kraken网站上注册或使用Kraken暗网时，匿名性不仅是一个选项，而且是必需的。

title: Google is investing in Arkansas with a new data center, energy efficiency programs and more.
title_zh: 谷歌在阿肯色州投资建设新数据中心并推出能效项目
summary_en: Google invests $4 billion in Arkansas for a data center, AI infrastructure, renewable energy, and workforce training programs.
summary_zh: 谷歌投资40亿美元在阿肯色州建设数据中心、AI基础设施、可再生能源和劳动力培训项目。
best_quote_en: We're boosting the state's talent pipeline by offering no-cost access to Google AI courses and Career Certificates for all residents.
best_quote_zh: 我们通过为所有居民提供免费的谷歌AI课程和职业证书来增强该州的人才输送渠道。

title: Upcoming Currency Change in Bulgaria
title_zh: 保加利亚即将发生的货币变更
summary_en: Bulgaria will adopt the euro on January 1, 2026, affecting App Store pricing and developer payments with specific conversion procedures.
summary_zh: 保加利亚将于2026年采用欧元，影响App Store定价和开发者支付流程。
best_quote_en: The statutory fixed conversion rate is 1.95583 BGN = 1 EUR as established by the Council of the European Union.
best_quote_zh: 欧盟理事会确定的法定固定兑换率为1.95583保加利亚列弗=1欧元。

title: GitHub Copilot CLI: Enhanced model selection, image support, and streamlined UI
title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI：增强模型选择、图像支持和简化界面
summary_en: GitHub Copilot CLI adds Claude Sonnet 4.5 support, image recognition, shell command execution, and improved interface with enhanced permissions.
summary_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI新增Claude Sonnet 4.5支持、图像识别、直接执行命令和权限控制改进。
best_quote_en: Take precise control over what Copilot CLI can execute with enhanced tool permissions using glob patterns in --allow-tool and --deny-tool flags.
best_quote_zh: 使用--allow-tool和--deny-tool标志中的通配符模式，通过增强工具权限精确控制Copilot CLI可执行内容。

title: AI花17小时写了篇30页论文！自主选题，包含实验，还符合APA格式
title_zh: AI花17小时写了篇30页论文！自主选题，包含实验，还符合APA格式
summary_en: An AI system autonomously conducted cognitive psychology research, designing experiments and writing a 30-page paper in 17 hours.
summary_zh: AI系统在17小时内自主完成认知心理学研究，包括实验设计和30页论文撰写。
best_quote_en: The AI's autonomous research capability stems from collaboration + simulating human cognitive mechanisms + dynamic knowledge interaction.
best_quote_zh: 其自主科研能力源于协作+模拟人类认知机制+动态知识交互的技术设计。

title: New ways to build with Jules, our AI coding agent
title_zh: 使用我们的AI编码助手Jules的新构建方式
summary_en: Google's AI coding agent Jules now offers CLI tools and API integration for enhanced developer workflow control and flexibility.
summary_zh: 谷歌AI编码助手Jules推出CLI工具和API，增强开发者工作流程控制与灵活性。
best_quote_en: These launches are about control and flexibility, two things we've heard you ask for repeatedly.
best_quote_zh: 这些发布关乎控制和灵活性，这是我们反复听到你们要求的两件事。

title: Get ready with the latest beta releases
title_zh: 准备迎接最新测试版发布
summary_en: Apple releases beta versions of iOS 26.1 and other operating systems for developers to test their apps.
summary_zh: 苹果发布iOS 26.1等操作系统测试版，供开发者测试应用兼容性。
best_quote_en: Get your apps ready by confirming they work as expected on these releases.
best_quote_zh: 准备好您的应用程序，确认它们在这些版本上按预期工作。

title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 is now available in Visual Studio, JetBrains IDEs, Xcode, and Eclipse
title_zh: Claude Sonnet 4.5 现已在 Visual Studio、JetBrains IDE、Xcode 和 Eclipse 中可用
summary_en: Claude Sonnet 4.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot across major IDEs including Visual Studio, JetBrains, Xcode, and Eclipse for Pro, Business, and Enterprise users.
summary_zh: Claude Sonnet 4.5 现已在 GitHub Copilot 中面向专业和企业用户提供，支持主流开发环境。
best_quote_en: Claude Sonnet 4.5 is available in public preview to GitHub Copilot Pro, Pro+, Business, and Enterprise plans.
best_quote_zh: Claude Sonnet 4.5 现以公开预览版形式向 GitHub Copilot Pro、Pro+、Business 和 Enterprise 计划提供。

title: 陶哲轩用GPT-5解决数学难题：仅29行Python代码
title_zh: 陶哲轩用GPT-5解决数学难题：仅29行Python代码
summary_en: Terence Tao used GPT-5 to solve a complex mathematical problem, generating a concise 29-line Python script for verification.
summary_zh: 陶哲轩利用GPT-5解决数学难题，仅用29行Python代码验证结果。
best_quote_en: "Without AI, I almost certainly would not have attempted this kind of numerical search."
best_quote_zh: “如果没有AI帮忙，我几乎不可能尝试进行这种数值搜索。”

title: Accelerating Qwen3-8B Agent on Intel® Core™ Ultra with Depth-Pruned Draft Models
title_zh: 使用深度修剪草稿模型在英特尔® Core™ Ultra 上加速 Qwen3-8B Agent
summary_en: Intel researchers accelerate Qwen3-8B agent performance by 1.4x using speculative decoding with a pruned draft model on Core™ Ultra processors.
summary_zh: 英特尔研究人员使用修剪草稿模型的推测解码，在Core™ Ultra处理器上将Qwen3-8B智能体性能提升1.4倍。
best_quote_en: This demonstrates how pruning + speculative decoding can unlock faster and more efficient inference—making local AI agents even more practical.
best_quote_zh: 这展示了修剪+推测解码如何实现更快、更高效的推理——使本地AI智能体更加实用。

title: 明尼苏达州批准收购案，贝莱德基础设施业务获助力
title_zh: 明尼苏达州批准收购案，贝莱德基础设施业务获助力
summary_en: Minnesota regulators approved BlackRock's $6.2 billion acquisition of Allete to support clean energy infrastructure investments.
summary_zh: 明尼苏达州批准贝莱德62亿美元收购阿勒特，助力清洁能源基础设施投资。
best_quote_en: The agreement enables the company 'to meet the significant infrastructure needs required for the clean energy transition' while maintaining service quality, reliability, and affordability.
best_quote_zh: 该协议使公司'能够满足清洁能源转型所需的重大基础设施需求'，同时不影响服务质量、供电可靠性与价格合理性。

title: Not your grandpa’s nuclear
title_zh: 非传统的核能
summary_en: Startups are developing smaller, cheaper modular nuclear reactors with tech backing to power data centers.
summary_zh: 初创公司正在开发更小更便宜的模块化核反应堆，获得科技巨头支持为数据中心供电。
best_quote_en: These next-gen reactors are designed to prioritize cost efficiency through simplification.
best_quote_zh: 这些下一代反应堆旨在通过简化设计来优先考虑成本效率。

title: [Outliers] Ed Stack: Lessons from Dick’s Sporting Goods
title_zh: [异类] Ed Stack: 迪克体育用品公司的经验教训
source: Farnam Street (FS Blog, Thinking & Growth, English)
summary_en: Ed Stack shares hard-won business wisdom from building Dick's Sporting Goods from near-bankruptcy to an 800-store empire.
summary_zh: Ed Stack分享将迪克体育用品从濒临破产打造成800家门店帝国的商业智慧。
best_quote_en: "Trust isn't earned in the easy times; it's earned in the fire."
best_quote_zh: 信任不是在顺境中获得的，而是在烈火中锻造的。

title: Protected: The Society Exclusive Access – The Financial Independence Summit Event Page: Video Recordings, Resources and Workbook
title_zh: 保护内容：The Society 独家访问 – 财务独立峰会活动页面：视频录像、资源和手册
summary_en: Password-protected exclusive access to Financial Independence Summit recordings, resources, and workbook materials.
summary_zh: 受密码保护的财务独立峰会独家视频、资源和手册访问。
best_quote_en: This content is password protected. To view it please enter your password below.
best_quote_zh: 此内容受密码保护。要查看请输入您的密码。

title: 4 tips for using Nano Banana to create amazing images
title_zh: 使用Nano Banana创建精彩图像的4个技巧
summary_en: Google's Nano Banana offers precise image editing and generation with multimodal AI for creative applications.
summary_zh: 谷歌Nano Banana通过多模态AI实现精准图像编辑和生成，拓展创意应用。
best_quote_en: "It's a giant quality leap, especially for image editing. We're putting capabilities that used to require specialized tools into the hands of everyday creators."
best_quote_zh: “这是质量的巨大飞跃，尤其是在图像编辑方面。我们将过去需要专业工具的功能交到了日常创作者手中。”

title: 1,001 real-world gen AI use cases from the world's leading organizations
title_zh: 全球领先组织的 1,001 个真实世界生成式 AI 应用案例
summary_en: Google Cloud showcases 1,001 real-world generative AI use cases across industries, demonstrating practical applications and measurable benefits.
summary_zh: 谷歌云展示跨行业 1,001 个真实生成式 AI 应用案例，涵盖实际应用场景与可量化效益。
best_quote_en: AI will grow beyond even our imagination as our customers continue to challenge us to design, build, deploy, and create value.
best_quote_zh: 随着客户不断挑战我们去设计、构建、部署并创造价值，AI 将发展得超乎我们的想象。

title: New requirement for apps using Sign in with Apple for account creation
title_zh: 使用Apple登录进行账户创建的新要求
summary_en: Apple requires Korean developers to implement server-to-server notification endpoints for Sign in with Apple starting 2026.
summary_zh: 苹果要求韩国开发者自2026年起为Apple登录实现服务器间通知端点。
best_quote_en: Account changes are directly related to privacy and control for the user and their personal data.
best_quote_zh: 账户变更直接关系到用户隐私及其个人数据的控制权。

title: GitHub Copilot CLI: Faster, more concise, and prettier
title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI：更快、更简洁、更美观
summary_en: GitHub Copilot CLI improvements deliver faster responses, streamlined interface, and enhanced Windows support.
summary_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 更新带来更快响应、简化界面和增强的Windows支持。
best_quote_en: Copilot now responds more concisely to simple questions, delivering you answers faster and keeping you focused on the task at hand.
best_quote_zh: Copilot 现在对简单问题回应更简洁，更快提供答案，让您专注于当前任务。

title: 找出iPhone漏洞，库克给你200万美元
title_zh: 找出iPhone漏洞，库克给你200万美元
summary_en: Apple doubles its bug bounty program with record $2-5 million rewards for critical security vulnerabilities.
summary_zh: 苹果将漏洞赏金最高奖金翻倍至200万美元，激励安全研究。
best_quote_en: We want top researchers who can crack the most difficult vulnerabilities and handle the most complex threats to receive substantial rewards matching their technical capabilities and time investment.
best_quote_zh: 我们希望那些能破解最棘手漏洞、应对最复杂威胁的顶尖研究人员，能因其技术能力和时间精力获得丰厚回报。

title: VibeGame: Exploring Vibe Coding Games
title_zh: VibeGame：探索氛围编程游戏
summary_en: VibeGame is a high-level game engine designed for AI-assisted development, solving context management and abstraction issues in vibe coding.
summary_zh: VibeGame是为AI辅助开发设计的高级游戏引擎，解决氛围编程中的上下文管理和抽象问题。
best_quote_en: VibeGame combines the best of both: the web stack's excellent AI performance and Roblox's perfect abstraction.
best_quote_zh: VibeGame结合了两者的优点：Web技术栈的卓越AI性能和Roblox的完美抽象。

title: 上海香港跻身全球海洋城市十强
title_zh: 上海香港跻身全球海洋城市十强
summary_en: Shanghai and Hong Kong rank among the top ten global marine cities in the 2025 competitiveness index report.
summary_zh: 上海与香港在全球海洋城市竞争力报告中跻身前十强。
best_quote_en: Shanghai, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Sydney, Hamburg, Oslo, and Rotterdam also rank in the top ten, forming the leading group of global marine cities alongside 'New York, London, Singapore'.
best_quote_zh: 上海、东京、香港、悉尼、汉堡、奥斯陆、鹿特丹等城市也跻身前十，与“纽伦新”共同组成全球海洋城市的头部阵营。

title: JPMorgan requires biometric scanning at new HQ
title_zh: 摩根大通新总部要求生物识别扫描
summary_en: JPMorgan mandates biometric scanning for employee access at its new Manhattan headquarters, enhancing security after a nearby shooting.
summary_zh: 摩根大通在曼哈顿新总部强制员工使用生物识别扫描，以加强安全措施。
best_quote_en: Instead of scanning badges, employees will have to take a more hands-on approach, offering up their palms or fingerprints.
best_quote_zh: 员工不再扫描徽章，而是必须采用更亲力亲为的方式，提供手掌或指纹。

title: Tracy Britt Cool: Brick by Brick
title_zh: Tracy Britt Cool：一砖一瓦
source: Farnam Street (FS Blog, Thinking & Growth, English)
summary_en: Warren Buffett's 'fireman' shares insights on business turnarounds, leadership, and capital allocation from her Berkshire Hathaway experience.
summary_zh: 巴菲特称为“消防员”的Tracy分享从伯克希尔学到的企业转型、领导力和资本配置智慧。
best_quote_en: "How incentives, culture, and structure line up to create lasting success"
best_quote_zh: “激励、文化和结构如何协调一致，创造持久成功”

title: Protected: The Financial Independence Summit Event Page: Video Recordings, Resources and Workbook
title_zh: 受保护：财务独立峰会活动页面：视频录像、资源和工作手册
summary_en: A password-protected resource hub for financial independence content with recordings and materials.
summary_zh: 受密码保护的财务独立资源中心，包含视频录像和学习材料。
best_quote_en: This content is password protected. To view it please enter your password below.
best_quote_zh: 此内容受密码保护。请在下方输入密码查看。

title: Gemini Enterprise: The new front door for Google AI in your workplace
title_zh: Gemini Enterprise：工作场所中Google AI的新入口
summary_en: Google launches Gemini Enterprise, an AI platform integrating company data and tools to transform workplace workflows.
summary_zh: 谷歌推出Gemini Enterprise，整合公司数据和工具，变革工作流程的AI平台。
best_quote_en: Gemini Enterprise is designed on the premise that true business transformation in the era of AI must go beyond simple chatbots.
best_quote_zh: Gemini Enterprise的设计前提是，AI时代真正的业务转型必须超越简单的聊天机器人。
